title: A reasonable, general-purpose task the registry has nothing for
rationale: NO_MATCH must cost almost nothing and leave no trace in the work. If a failed search degrades the answer, search-before-generate is a net loss on every miss. Candidate submission is "any" deliberately: Roman-numeral parsing is deterministic, general-purpose and useful elsewhere, which is precisely what the Skill says to offer, so this scenario has no business scoring it either way.
